description: OpenBuildingMap is a global building exposure dataset of about 2.7 billion building footprints, each enriched with occupancy type and height classified in the GEM Building Taxonomy, organised in zoom-level 6 quadkey tiles. It was produced at the GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences by Laurens Oostwegel, Danijel Schorlemmer, Lars Lingner and Tara Evaz Zadeh, published by GFZ Data Services in 2025 and funded by the EU Geo-INQUIRE project (grant 101058518); a Zenodo copy of the description was added in May 2026. It merges Google's Open Buildings and Microsoft's Global ML Building Footprints with crowdsourced OpenStreetMap, with quality checked against cadastre data and the Global Human Settlement Layer. Coverage is global, from data collected in July 2024. Access: GeoPackage tiles from the OpenBuildingMap download portal. Licence: Open Database License (ODbL); free. Caveats: occupancy and height are inferred for most buildings and quality varies with the underlying sources. Simulation uses: building-by-building exposure for natural hazard risk, crisis management and urban planning. Related records: OpenStreetMap, the Nigeria building footprint typology dataset and the global building height and material stock maps.
